citation: Yohannes and Amagasa (2022), A method of named entity recognition for Tigrinya, ACM SIGAPP Applied Computing Review 22(3):56-68, doi:10.1145/3570733.3570737
split: random 80/10/10 derived here (the release ships no official split); seed recorded below
note: Not MasakhaNER: MasakhaNER 1.0 and 2.0 do not include Tigrinya. The tag set includes MISC, which MasakhaNER 2.0 does not use. data/scripts/prepare_ner.py skips 6 source lines that have no tag column and normalises malformed tags: B-DATe -> B-DATE; IO and BO -> O. One B-LO tag (train only) is left as it is.
